scene_summary: A pale, heavily textured ground supports a large skull-like violet-gray assemblage at left, a separate curled violet fragment at upper right, and a rust-red and gold shelf at lower right. Paired black hollows, sharp ivory blades, teal insets, a small branching colored ridge, and a scraped multicolored pocket provide distinct visible interaction anchors. Thin raised ivory threads cross the open ground. The plate is expressionist and spatially restrained, though its main forms contain dense surface detail. Not every planned spatial relationship is present: the conspicuous ivory ledge belongs to the left assemblage, and the rust shelf sits beneath the right fragment rather than beneath the larger left cluster.
usable_surfaces: Violet-gray dome and paired black hollows
Curled violet fold with a blue interior and fractured ivory chips
Green-blue branching ridge with orange and pink accents
Projecting ivory ledge on the left assemblage
Rust-red shelf with a rough gold overlap and pale vertical bars
Blue-pink-black scraped pocket beneath the left ivory ledge

detected_objects.label: Broad violet-gray dome above paired dark hollows and fractured ivory blades
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The large left mass has a broad rounded lavender-gray crown, two deep black eye-like cavities, and long, sharp cream-colored planes descending between and below them. The polygon follows the crown and descending blade silhouette rather than including the separate branching ridge, projecting horizontal ledge, or lower scraped pocket.

detected_objects.label: Sweeping violet fold with blue-violet interior and pale fractured chips
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The detached upper-right fragment has a lavender upper flap, a dark violet folded right side, and a blue-violet curl sweeping underneath a broken cream center. Its lower tail bends down and right; its outer right lip forms a sharp horizontal projection.

detected_objects.label: Branching green-blue ridge with orange tips and pink streaks
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A small antler-like green and teal ridge branches from the upper-left flank of the large mass. Orange pigment caps the far-left and upper-right tips, while pink streaks run along the diagonal arm. A dark scraped patch lies behind its base. This feature is distinct from the larger teal blade-like insets.

detected_objects.label: Chunky projecting ivory ledge across the left assemblage
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A thick cream ledge projects horizontally leftward, with layered scraping along its face, an uneven lower lip, and a pointed right end. This is the clearest chunky ivory ledge in the plate. It sits on the large left assemblage above the colored pocket, not below the separate upper-right violet fold; the planned long-striated fold relationship is not clearly realized.

detected_objects.label: Detached rust-red shelf with rough gold overlap and broken pale bars
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The lower-right detached form has a rough red-brown horizontal shelf, a crumpled ochre-gold overlap on top, and broken ivory and lavender vertical bars beneath it. Dense black-brown tangles trail downward between the bars. The shelf is clearly visible, but its position differs from the planned placement beneath the larger cluster.

detected_objects.label: Scraped blue-pink-black pocket below an ivory lip
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Immediately beneath the left ivory ledge, a ragged exposed patch contains cobalt blue at left, dusty pink across its upper center, and broken black pigment at right and below. Pale scumbling interrupts the colors and makes an irregular speckled perimeter. The contour excludes the large ledge above it.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Estimated mapped coverage is about 43 percent. Three separated assemblages retain a readable expressionist composition and substantial pale ground. Dense cracks, blade overlaps, trailing black tangles, and additional raised ivory threads make the plate more intricate than strictly minimal, but it is not broadly cluttered. Small anchors remain visually distinguishable. Planned placement discrepancies should not be resolved by inventing extra marks.
